title.text: Two files that need each other

runs.text: The sales file imports the receipts file, and the receipts file imports the sales file. What is the problem?
Dependencies have to go in a single direction. If two files need each other, what they share usually deserves a third file that both depend on.
Neither can be understood or tested without the other: there is a circular dependency.

justification.text: To test the sales you need the receipts, and to test the receipts, the sales.
It is true that importing runs nothing, but the cycle ties both files together forever.
The problem is not speed, but that both files can no longer be separated.
